label: Bible Study
prompt: In whose _____ is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.
verse: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.
note: Job's answer to his friends — even the beasts know whose hand holds every living breath.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Watch and _____, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
verse: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
note: Spoken in Gethsemane to sleepy disciples — Jesus knows the spirit is willing even when the flesh nods off.

label: Sunday School
prompt: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my _____.
verse: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.
note: Breakfast on the beach, then a question for Peter — and a job: 'Feed my lambs.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our _____, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
verse: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
note: Paul's case for reading the Old Testament: it was written for us, to fuel patience, comfort and hope.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The fire shall ever be _____ upon the altar; it shall never go out.
verse: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.
note: The altar fire was never to go out — it 'shall ever be burning' — a favorite picture of devotion that never cools.
